reviews.title: Coasting off their past sucess
reviews.text:
Recently transitioned to iOS after many years on android. This app captured the rude awakening I had in using iPhone apps. Always spamming you with paywall before you even get to know what you’re paying for. 

But what really told me what the app was going to be like was the video that spammed my screen at the beginning which somehow froze the app for a but when I hit “continue”. At least if you are enticing me to pay, make sure the video doesn’t slow down the app.

reviews.title: Premium price, poor value
reviews.text: As others have said, they’ve removed the free options. This was the only app that let me make simple custom icons the way I prefer, rather than only having default options or horrible design tools. It had lots of ads but that was fine.  Now they’ve integrated ugly AI and require a subscription to even browse the options. There’s no way $30 per month is worth it for any wallpaper app.

You may as well just add a price to this app , can’t use anything unless you use a free trial , I didn’t want a free trial I simply just wanted a cute wallpaper. Don’t advertise as a free app if the app is NOT FREE , thanks. That is all. 
0 stars.
